operator.project: SISO_Agency/apps/oracle-operator (Oracle streaming operator dashboard; React 19, Tailwind 4, shadcn base-nova, recharts, lucide)
rules: Everything in the bank is fair game for the operator unless Shaan's note says otherwise (his standing rule, 2026-09-04).
A ★ winner or ✓ keep outranks bank_score. His quote is the acceptance criterion; read it before adapting.
Mobile-form comps can be fitted to desktop; desktop-form comps cannot go the other way.
Adapt to tenants/oracle/dna.md, never paste. Pills only for count badges. One-ink alpha ladder. Off-round values.
The AI assistant should pop up from an input, not live in a permanent panel (his call on ai-input).
Robbability < 3 on a scout row means heavy deps or no source; budget for a rebuild.
Gamification and dopamine comps are for the model side first (his note on achievement badges).
Streaming text + thinking tool are for Oracle in the models app.
He deliberately skipped landing comps; only bento-card and onboarding-dialog were kept. Use registry/21st/find.mjs for the rest.
